snippet.title: Why Is Every Football Goal 8 Feet High? ⚽🤯  #football #worldcup #shorts
snippet.description:
is exactly 8 feet (2.44 meters) high?

The answer goes back more than 140 years. Early football goals didn't even have a crossbar—they used a simple rope. Constant arguments over whether the ball went over or under the rope led to one of football's most important rule changes.

In 1882, a solid crossbar was introduced at exactly 8 feet, creating the perfect balance between rewarding accurate shots and giving goalkeepers a fair chance.

That same measurement is still used in professional football around the world today.

Would you make the crossbar higher or lower? Let us know in the comments! 👇
